@deskInvNoticePaid.description: Notice: a payer paid an invoice this wallet issued; the wallet finalized it. payer is the contact name or a short address; amount is the number only; EPIC follows it.

@deskInvNoticeDeclined.description: Warning notice: the payer declined an invoice this wallet issued; the wallet withdrew it.

deskInvNoticeIssuedExpired: An invoice you issued expired unpaid.

@deskInvNoticeIssuedExpired.description: Notice: an invoice this wallet issued ran out of time unpaid.

deskInvNoticeWithdrawn: {service} withdrew an invoice before you answered it.

@deskInvNoticeWithdrawn.description: Notice: a service withdrew an invoice that was waiting for the user. service is the user's label for it.

deskInvNoticeExpired: An invoice expired before you answered it.

@deskInvNoticeExpired.description: Notice: an invoice waiting for the user ran out of time.

deskInvNoticeUnknownPayment: A payment for an invoice this device did not issue arrived and was refused. If another device with this wallet issued it, ask the payer to cancel and pay again.

@deskInvNoticeUnknownPayment.description: Warning notice (desktop and phone): LEPIC refused the payment of an invoice it does not know; another install on the same recovery phrase may have issued it. Unverified: names no sender.

deskInvNoticeUnknownAnswer: An answer to a payment this device did not send arrived and was refused. If another device with this wallet sent it, cancel it there and send again.

@deskInvNoticeUnknownAnswer.description: Warning notice (desktop and phone): LEPIC refused the answer to a send it does not know; another install on the same recovery phrase may have made it. Unverified: names no sender.
